description: What the window is allowed to do to itself. Tauri v2 denies every plugin command that is not listed here, and denies it silently — which is why dragging the title bar did nothing for four attempts, and why the dock badge never appeared. The same is true of a plugin's *scope*: `opener:default` permits `http`, `https`, `mailto` and `tel` and nothing else, so the microphone dialog's deep link into System Settings needs the entry below or it opens nothing and reports nothing.
